name: EzImageAI
tagline: Edit any photo with a prompt, using top AI image models
description: EzImageAI is a browser-based AI image editor built around prompts instead of fixed templates. Upload a JPEG, PNG, or WebP, describe the change you want (a new background, a recolored product, different lighting, a whole new style), and review the result in one workspace. Signed-in users can also start from a text prompt alone, with an optional reference image. Twelve image models across GPT Image, Nano Banana, and Seedream families. Private assets and edit history; credit cost shown before you generate.
